holes.note: Blind tee shot; approach over water.
Often called the hardest hole: plays into the prevailing wind with water.

West.blurb: Ted Robinson design (1980). Demanding front nine (6 & 7 stand out); back nine opens up. Bermuda fairways.

East.blurb: Ted Robinson design. Considered a touch harder than the West: tighter fairways, smaller greens, 14 of 18 holes dogleg — a target course.
